changelog: **Added** — a mentee requesting a meeting now picks from their mentor's posted weekly hours, expanded into concrete date-times for the next three weeks and resolved in the mentor's time zone (DST-correct). The mentor's request list marks which requests landed on their own hours. A mentor who has posted no hours is unchanged: the free-text request stays. Closes the loop the landing FAQ has been promising — until now nothing in the product read an availability slot.

en: Ask for a meeting by picking one of your mentor's available hours instead of typing a time and hoping.
tr: Artık saat yazıp ummak yerine mentörünün müsait saatlerinden birini seçerek toplantı isteyebilirsin.
de: Frage ein Meeting an, indem du eine der freien Zeiten deiner Mentorin oder deines Mentors wählst, statt eine Zeit zu raten.
